capabilities: Insert local files into notes as embeds
Preview docx, xlsx, pptx, html and csv files inline
Show a file card for unsupported formats
Scope embeds to pages, slides, sheets, cell ranges or headings
Open files in a full tab with outline, search and position memory
extras: Free and MIT-licensed with no network requests; HTML embeds may still load external assets referenced by the embedded page. Opening files with the system app or revealing them in the file manager is desktop-only.
intentEvidence: Write ![[filename.ext]] in a note to preview it inline
problem: Obsidian renders only a few file types natively, so Office documents and HTML files kept in a vault cannot be viewed inside notes.

relations.evidence: Compared to WASM-based viewers (e.g. styled-ms-office-viewer), docx/pptx fidelity is lower; both can coexist
HTML sandbox approach adapted from mnaoumov/obsidian-embed-html

summary: Inserts and previews Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML and CSV files inside notes, with a file card fallback for other types.
